# Fixtures

`uploaded.json` and `not_signed_in.json` are the example answers of the "DHV XC Flight Upload Interface Specification", version 2022-04-24, copied from the annex of the DHV-XC's rules on 2026-11-20. They are the specification's examples, not answers recorded from the DHV-XC: nothing in this project has talked to it yet.

`upload_request.json` is the request this crate builds for a made-up pilot and a made-up three-line file.
